controllerType: EC5 overlock sewing machine panel V1.8
source: C5包缝机说明书_中英文.pdf (V1.8, 2019-10-17, bilingual Chinese/English, 24 pages)
note: EC5 controller for C5 overlock machine. LCD panel with 11 buttons including voice navigation and short thread. Three sewing modes: full automatic (全智能), semi-automatic (半智能), full computerized (全电脑). Voice broadcast feature in Chinese and multiple languages. Model type set via P94 (electric/pneumatic/side suction). Parameters P26/P28/P35 have different defaults depending on model type. Contains process parameters (U-series, entered via P + down button). Monitoring M50-M58 require P90=1.

buttons.name: Up (+)
buttons.description: Increase speed (+100 RPM); increase parameter value

buttons.name: Down (-)

buttons.description: Control machine head LCD light brightness (4 brightness levels cycling); navigate parameter right

buttons.name: Presser Foot Lifter
buttons.description: Change auto presser foot lifter mode (cycles Front/Back/Front+Back/Closed/Speed Reduction U18/Thin-Thick speed reduction U20)

buttons.name: Trimmer Parameter Setting
buttons.description: Change thread length and trimming on/off switch

buttons.name: Reset
buttons.description: Long press 1.5s: restore user saved parameters. Long press Left+Right 1.5s: restore factory parameters

buttons.name: Voice Navigation
buttons.description: Voice broadcast switch. Long press 1.5s: toggle voice on/off. Short press: toggle startup welcome voice. When error: short press broadcasts current error solution.

parameterEntry.userParams: Long press P for 1.5s → enter user parameter mode. Left/right buttons choose parameter item. Up/down buttons modify value. Press P to confirm and save. Press left or right without saving to return. Press P again to exit to standby. 5s with no button press: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.technicianParams: Press P + Presser Foot Lifter button simultaneously for 1.5s → shows P26. Left/right to navigate, up/down to modify, P to save. 5s without press: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.processParams: Press P + Down button for 1.5s → shows U01. Same navigation as technician params.
parameterEntry.systemParams: Press P + Up button → password input → enter '111' → confirm.
parameterEntry.monitoring: Press P + Right button → enter monitoring interface. Left/right adjust monitoring items. Press P to enter current value. Short press P in monitoring value to exit.
parameterEntry.speedAdjust: In standby: up/down buttons adjust max speed ±100 RPM each press. Press P to confirm and save. 5s without press: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.voiceLanguage: Press Left button to switch voice language. Current language plays. Press P to confirm change.
parameterEntry.LEDBrightness: In standby: press Right button to cycle LED brightness through 4 levels (one is off).
parameterEntry.buttonLock: Set P62=1 to lock buttons. Long press Trimmer Parameter button for 1.5s to unlock.
parameterEntry.antiCutClothShortcut: Long press P + Sensor for 3s to toggle anti-cutting cloth sensor on/off.
parameterEntry.clothPieceValueForceRemove: Under non-lock condition: long press Trimmer button for 1.5s — auto clears cloth piece value and shows CLC.
parameterEntry.fabricSelection: Long press Right button for 1s → enter fabric selection (H=normal, S=mesh, A=thin). Short press Right to cycle. Press P to save; auto recalibrates sensor voltage. Shows OK on success.
parameterEntry.sensorAutoCalibration: Long press P + Voice Navigation for 1.5s → sensor auto calibration starts. Shows OK if successful.
parameterEntry.shortThreadModeSwitch: Long press Short Thread button for 3s → toggle short thread mode. When on: fourth sensor auto enabled and recalibrated.
parameterEntry.thickMaterialThreshold: Long press Presser Foot Lifter for 1.5s → enter thick material threshold setting. Adjust presser foot height (cloth thickness). Press P to save to U15. Shows OK on success. Note: fails if saved value > base-50 or < U16.
parameterEntry.restoreFactory: Long press Reset for 1.5s: restore user saved params. Long press Left+Right for 1.5s: restore factory and linked params. Not restored: P19/P20 version, P66/P67/P68 adapter duty cycle, P73 factory speed, P90 monitoring enable, P94/P95 model selection.

sewingModes.note: Modifying P1/P3/P27/P28/P50 saves only for the current mode. Switching modes restores that mode's saved values. If user saves to user common params (P21=1), reset restores user saved params.

errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or rotating with difficulty. Check motor plug and sensor connection for loose or disconnected. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.
Check voltage is normal. Try factory reset or restart. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.

errorCodes.description: Connection problem of operation panel and control box
errorCodes.solution: Check if panel and control box connection is loose. Try factory reset or restart. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.
Turn off machine. Check motor plug connection and motor Hall connector for loose or disconnected. Restart after restoring to normal. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.
Turn off machine. Check motor needle position signal plug connection. Try factory reset. Restart after restoring. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.

errorCodes.description: Presser foot safety switch ON (presser foot protection enabled)
errorCodes.solution: Check if presser foot is back to correct position. Temporarily set P57 parameter from 1 to 0. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.

errorCodes.description: Sewing plate safety switch ON (sewing plate protection enabled)
errorCodes.solution: Check if sewing table is back to correct position. Temporarily set P58 from 1 to 0. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.

errorCodes.description: Needle bar cover safety switch ON

Check if pedal plug is connected to control box or loose. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.
Check if power supply voltage is normal. Try factory reset or restart. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.

alarmCodes.description: Panel and electronic control models do not match
alarmCodes.solution: Upgrade electronic control and panel programs to matching programs.
Perform regular white grease maintenance. Adjustable via PA1 parameter.
Perform regular cleaning maintenance. Adjustable via PA0 parameter.

alarmCodes.solution: Check IoT collector and gateway connection.

alarmCodes.solution: Check if connection between panel and collector is normal.
Check oil level of sewing machine.
Check thick material switching sensor and presser foot height settings.

troubleshooting.issue: Thread tail too long before sewing
troubleshooting.solution: Increase P27 (delay stitches number of trimmer before sewing). More stitches = shorter thread tail.

troubleshooting.issue: Thread tail too long after sewing
troubleshooting.solution: Decrease P28 (delay stitches after sewing). Fewer stitches = shorter tail. Note: P28 or P50 is adjusted by the Trimmer shortcut button depending on P32 state.

troubleshooting.cause: Anti-cutting cloth sensor not calibrated or disabled
troubleshooting.solution: Enable P32=1. Long press P + Sensor 3s for quick on/off toggle. Run sensor auto-calibration (P + Voice for 1.5s).

troubleshooting.cause: Voice disabled or volume too low
troubleshooting.solution: Long press Voice Navigation button for 1.5s to toggle voice. Set P6=2 or higher for volume. Check P80 for language setting.

troubleshooting.cause: Short thread mode off or fourth sensor disabled
troubleshooting.solution: Long press Short Thread button for 3s to toggle. Check U22=1 and U24=1. Sensor auto-calibration may be needed.

troubleshooting.issue: E06 presser foot protection alarm won't clear
troubleshooting.cause: Presser foot not in correct position
troubleshooting.solution: Place presser foot in correct position, then press P to clear E06. If temporary workaround needed: set P57=0 to disable presser foot safety switch.
